result.summary: Found 1 notable visual issue: a lower content card is being obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, which makes the page look clipped and may hide tappable content.

issues.description: The restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so part of the content is hidden behind the persistent navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last card clears the fixed navigation bar, or make the tab bar non-overlapping with the content area.
